name: Iwataki (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Iwataki town emblem in purple: a disc crossed by white horizontal bars with a stylised character.
history: Flag of the former town of Iwataki in Kyoto Prefecture, dissolved on 2006-03-01.
